# Map Shows Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State 2 Months Until Midterms

Published

Sep 03, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

updated

Sep 03, 2026 at 12:34 PM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

With two months to go until Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections, new polling shows President Donald Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term.

The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on August 31, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

####
results.title: Map Shows Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State 2 Months Until Midterms

results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.
